name: Statute Sayacap
description: Stand on the court line with the shaft slanted so the guard moves with each small step.

name: Steelkake
description: Slice across the foe's guard in time with the advancing court step.

name: Kake Verdict
description: Thrust the point along the court line between the foe's two hands.

name: Thunderclap Ishizukibase
description: Take two court steps and sweep on the second with light qi in the long edge.

name: Sunevow
description: Turn the shaft against the foe's attack at the moment the lead foot lands.

name: Thrall Uchiotoshi
description: Draw the foe's weapon along the court line and hold it with the shaft until the next step.

name: Bedrock Ishizuki
description: Enter the foe's court with a long step and reap across both his hands in one cut.

name: Undefiled Nagaheel
description: Anchor the butt cap on the court line and brace the shaft to hold against a charge.

name: Steelsukui
description: Blink from one end of the court line to the other and cut the foe in passing.

name: Royal Tempestuous Bladecurve
description: The school's closing cast sends two crescents out on matching court steps to cut every foe on the line.

name: Statute Tsubaring
description: Spread the arms along the shaft like wings with the blade raised above the lead shoulder.

name: Steelnaga
description: Cut with the edge of the lead wing across the foe's throat line.

name: Sukuicrown
description: Dart the tip forward like the point of a pinion into an unguarded gap.

name: Haemalsukui
description: Spread both arms wide at the start of the sweep so the arc takes the whole breadth of the stance.

name: Squall Nagatip
description: Turn one wing of the shaft outward to push aside a thrust and close it again behind.

name: Thrallsukui
description: Clamp the crook of the blade over the foe's weapon like a talon closing on a branch.

name: Merciful Nagashaft
description: Hold still with the blade lowered and read the whole field of motion through the shaft.

name: Sukui Banner
description: Stoop from a high guard and reap across the foe's front in one swift heavy arc.

name: Sainted Nagablade
description: Beat the shaft out and in with qi so a barrier of moving wood stops all blows from the front.

name: Bedrock Habakiring
description: Flash over the foe's guard on spread wings and rend his back with the falling edge.

name: Ishiverdict
description: The school's great cast opens the wings and reaps a wide arc of sky-pale qi edge across the field.

name: Habakiring Reliquary
description: Hold the shaft in a low bowl at the body with one end trailing like a stream.

name: Nagicrown
description: Slice out to the full reach of the river line along the foe's lead side.

name: Pulsar Kake
description: Thrust low along the floor of the basin to reach the foe's ankle.

name: Nagashaft Seal
description: Send a small ripple down the shaft and let it shed an attacker's weapon off the side.

name: Quenched Nagaheel
description: Fan the sweep out in two branching cuts like a river that divides to meet the sea.

name: Vigor Uchiotoshi
description: Join the foe's line from the side like a tributary and cut as the paths meet.

name: Haraipledge
description: Sink the foe's weapon into the bowl of the stance and hold it there under steady qi.

name: Venomsune
description: Drag the shaft along the ground like a current dragging silt and trip the foe's trailing foot.

name: Thunderclap Tsubaring
description: Spread a flat heavy stroke across the ground like a flood across a plain.

name: Bedrock Nagatip
description: Turn the shaft across the front as a weir and let the force of the charge pile up against it.

name: Bedrock Nagi
description: Surge across the basin in a flash and cut the foe as the current reaches the far bank.

name: Bladecurve Crown
description: The school's cast lets stored qi spill over the rim in one wide arc that reaps the whole basin.

name: Undefiled Nagablade
description: Set the blade curve and the shaft curve back to back in front of the chest.

name: Quenched Sukui
description: Cut a smooth crescent through the foe's guard and bring the blade back along its own curve.

name: Dauntless Ishizuki
description: Dart the very tip out at the end of a crescent to catch an unwary wrist.

name: Exalted Ishizukibase
description: Throw a crescent and its pair in one turn so the second comes from the foe's blind side.

name: Sunepledge
description: Hold the foe's weapon in the crook of the blade and press it down with the shaft.

name: Bedrock Mawashi
description: Step along the curve of the crescent so the body arrives beside the foe with the blade ready.

name: Inferno Sayacap
description: Reap with a great crescent that crosses the foe's whole body from hip to shoulder.

name: Nagaheel Troth
description: Cup the shaft in a crescent guard that takes a heavy blow and turns it upward.

name: Famed Tsubaring
description: Blink to the foe's far side and cut two crescents before he turns to face the blade.

name: Sunebanner
description: The school's last cast sets two great crescents on the field at once and each cuts all it meets.

name: Inviolate Nagashaft
description: Hold the shaft as two rails in front of the body one high and one low.

name: Haemalishi
description: Slice down the left rail in a long diagonal from the high shoulder.

name: Dauntless Harai
description: Thrust along the right rail in a straight line to the foe's lower chest.

name: Suneedict
description: Run two currents of qi along the shaft and sweep with both at once.

name: Sunetroth
description: Meet a blow on one rail and carry it across to the other so it leaves along a new line.

name: Peerless Kake
description: Switch rails with a quick step and cut from the line the foe was not guarding.

name: Millstone Nagi
description: Hook the foe's weapon along one rail and tie it to the other with the shaft.

name: Nagacrown
description: Cross two heavy strokes along both rails so they meet where the foe stands.

name: Ishitroth
description: Hold both rails of qi along the shaft and let them carry a heavy blow to the ground.

name: Triumphant Bladecurve
description: Jump from one rail to the next in a flash and rend the foe from an unexpected line.

name: Dauntless Nagatip Decree
description: The school's cast runs both rails of the qi field out into the sky and draws them down in one wide cut.

name: Prismnaga
description: Hold the shaft overhead in a shallow arc like a bowl of sky above the head and shoulders.

name: Bedrock Ishizukibase
description: Slice along the rim of the imagined bowl at the foe's guard arm.

name: Vaunted Harai
description: Thrust along the curve of the bowl so the point arrives from below the guard.

name: Unwavering Ishizuki
description: Tip the shaft like a bowl to pour an attacking weapon off to the side.

name: Squallishi
description: Sweep in a deep dish arc with qi drawn from the bowl above and poured into the edge.

name: Despotic Nagablade
description: Hook the foe's guard arm and pull it down into the bowl of the stance.

name: Squallsukui
description: Step round the rim of the bowl so the foe is always at its low centre.

name: Interstice Sayacap
description: Hold the haft as a still mirror and read the foe's motion in the way the surface trembles.

name: Steel Uchiotoshi
description: Reap down the whole slope of the bowl in one heavy qi-fed cut.

name: Gathering Nagashaft
description: Cup the stance around a still core of qi so every blow collects and falls harmlessly.

name: Nagatriumph
description: Flash down the slope of the bowl and cut the foe at its lowest point.

name: Intrepid Tempestuous Sukui
description: The school's cast draws the Core's power into one great bowl-shaped arc that reaps the whole field.

name: Steelishi
description: Face the wind with the blade steady and speak the first words of the oath.

name: Vigor Habakiring
description: Slice with the wind at the shoulder so the edge falls on the foe as a word is sworn.

name: Quenched Harai
description: Dart the blade tip along the sworn line at the foe's sword hand.

name: Gallant Harai
description: Sweep with a light gust of qi behind the oath so the edge keeps its line.

name: Ishizuki Troth
description: Brace the shaft against a blow and hold it as a sworn word is held.

name: Hooking Uchiotoshi
description: Hook the foe's weapon at the end of a stroke and pull it toward the oath line.

name: Deluge Bladecurve
description: Take one step into the wind where the oath can be seen and heard by the foe.

name: Thunderclap Sayacap
description: Reap with a stroke that carries the oath and a hard wind along the length of the edge.

name: Anchored Ishizukibase
description: Hold the guard against the wind as if anchored to the plateau by the words of the oath.

name: Vigor Nagablade
description: Flash on a sworn gust to the foe's flank and cut before the oath has finished echoing.

name: Famed Inferno Nagaheel
description: The school's cast speaks the whole oath and reaps one wide arc of wind-driven qi edge.

name: Faithful Habakiring
description: Hold the shaft true on a bearing across the flat of the plateau with the blade raised.

name: Paramount Tsubaring
description: Slice along the heading of the bearing at the foe's lead shoulder.

name: Radiance Nagatip
description: Poke the point along the bearing at a gap in the foe's guard.

name: Imperial Kake
description: Hold the bearing through a wide sweep so the edge never leaves its heading.

name: Parity Ishizukibase
description: Turn the shaft to the heading and let the blow glance away across it.

name: Squall Nagashaft
description: Enter the foe's reach along the bearing in two smooth even steps.

name: Peerless Sukui
description: Reap along the heading with a long stroke that carries the full weight of the stance.

name: Ishipledge
description: Hold the heading against a heavy press and let qi keep the shaft from turning off it.

name: Sukuitriumph
description: Flash along the bearing to the far side of the foe and cut as the heading closes.

name: Royal Magma Mawashi
description: The school's cast sets the bearing across the whole plateau and reaps every foe on that line.

name: Steel Sayacap
description: Stand with open air at the back and the blade raised ready to sweep any side.

name: Steel Nagi
description: Slice from high on one side to low on the other in a single wide stroke.

name: Pulsar Mawashi
description: Thrust the point out to the limit of the arm as if reaching for the far horizon.

name: Parity Nagaheel
description: Brush the shaft lightly across the incoming weapon as a gust brushes grass.

name: Steel Mawashi
description: Cast a long sweep under open sky with qi running free along the whole edge.

name: Thrall Bladecurve
description: Drift the shaft over the foe's weapon and bind it while the wind carries both sideways.

name: Squall Nagi
description: Run a few steps across open ground and cut as the foe turns to meet the blade.

name: Hospitable Nagablade
description: Hold the haft loose in the hands and feel the gusts to learn where the foe is moving.

name: Nagibanner
description: Reap under open sky with a heavy stroke fed by the whole rush of the wind.

name: Stopping Nagatip
description: Hold a guard that leaves the edge free to cut while the shaft stops the blow.

name: Haemalsune
description: Flash down from the open sky and cut the foe before the wind has stirred.

name: Inferno Harai
description: The school's cast gives the whole sweep to the wind and it reaps wherever the wind blows.

name: Ishivow
description: Hold the shaft with the edge turned toward the foe as the pledge of a sworn purpose.

name: Paramount Mawashi
description: Draw the edge across the foe's guard in one slow deliberate pull of the vow.

name: Prism Tsubaring
description: Drive the point straight at the foe's chest in the moment the oath is made.

name: Triumphant Kake
description: Sweep once in the name of the oath with qi pledged to the edge.

name: Devout Habakiring
description: Turn the haft to shed a blow and hold the pledge unbroken by its force.

name: Peremptory Sukui
description: Bind the foe's weapon to the shaft and hold it until the vow is spoken to its end.

name: Deluge Sukui
description: Press forward one step at a time on the line of the oath and give no ground back.

name: Kakedecree
description: Reap along the sworn line with a stroke that does not end until the foe is passed.

name: Immovable Ishizuki
description: Hold the guard with the shaft in the vow line and let no blow turn it.

name: Splendid Nagi
description: Flash to the foe along the vow line and rend him with an oath-weighted edge.

name: Gallant Magma Ishizukibase
description: The school's cast completes the oath in one wide reaping arc that answers all who stand against it.

name: Stately Nagablade
description: Hold a deep stance on the gale's heading with the shaft slanting into the wind.

name: Triumphant Nagatip
description: Draw the edge across the foe on the gale's heading with a long steady pull.

name: Gallant Nagashaft
description: Dart the point down the heading line at the hollow of the foe's throat.

name: Tsubaring Triumph
description: Sweep with the gale's heading so the cut rides the full length of the wind.

name: Consecrated Habakiring
description: Tilt the shaft along the heading and let a blow run off it like rain.

name: Inferno Bladecurve
description: Step down the heading and cut across the foe as the lead foot lands.

name: Vigorishi
description: Reap along the gale's heading with qi that grows as it travels toward the tip.

name: Season Nagaheel
description: Press the shaft down on the foe's weapon along the heading until he cannot lift it.

name: Bedrock Uchiotoshi
description: Flash down the heading with the gale and cut the foe at the end of the line.

name: Magma Ishizuki
description: The school's cast raises the gale along the heading and reaps the whole field in one great arc.

name: Nagapledge
description: Stand with the blade raised in the open wind and the shaft slanting to split each gust.

name: Quenched Mawashi
description: Slice from the open side of the stance in a long sweep with the wind behind the edge.

name: Vacuum Uchiotoshi
description: Thrust the point into the wind and let the draft lengthen the line of the stroke.

name: Parity Ishizuki
description: Flow with the wind across the incoming weapon and send it away with the shaft.

name: Squallkake
description: Sweep in the open wind with qi drawn from the Core and fed lightly to the edge.

name: Sigilharai
description: Hook the foe's guard and carry it off on the flow of the wind.

name: Illustrious Nagatip
description: Step in the open wind and cut as the gust drives the blade across the foe's front.

name: Peal Habakiring
description: Hold the haft light and feel the wind and the foe's motion through the grain of the wood.

name: Sovereign Nagi
description: Reap in the open wind with a stroke that borrows the whole force of the gust.

name: Bedrock Nagaheel
description: Hold the guard and let the wind flow around the shaft without moving it.

name: Uchiotoshi Triumph
description: Flash across the open wind and rend the foe with the edge before the gust has settled.

name: Reaping Kake
description: The school's cast loosens the Core's power into one open-wind arc that reaps the whole field.
